src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTiming.java
   1: package com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction;
   2: 
   3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
   4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
   5: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
   6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
   7: import java.time.Instant;
   8: import java.util.UUID;
   9: import java.util.function.Consumer;
  10: import java.util.function.LongSupplier;
  11: 
  12: /** FIX-129: observational wall-duration measurements, never decision inputs.
  13:  * nanoTime measures elapsed work including transaction commit/rollback. UTC wall
  14:  * timestamps locate observations; Binance event time is retained separately.
  15:  */
  16: @Component
  17: public class KlineTiming {
  18:     private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KlineTiming.class);
  19:     private final LongSupplier nanos;
  20:     private final Consumer<Measurement> sink;
  21:     public record Context(String correlationId, String symbol, String interval,
  22:                           Instant candleOpenTime, Instant observedAt, Instant blockStart) {}
  23:     public record Measurement(Context context, String stage, Instant startedAt, Instant finishedAt,
  24:                               long elapsedMs, String outcome, String threadName) {}
  25:     @Autowired
  26:     public KlineTiming(KlineTimingStore store) { this(System::nanoTime, store::submit); }
  27:     KlineTiming(LongSupplier nanos, Consumer<Measurement> sink) {
  28:         this.nanos = nanos; this.sink = sink;
  29:     }
  30:     // Directly constructed legacy unit-test subjects still get logging, without a database.
  31:     public static KlineTiming loggingOnly() { return new KlineTiming(System::nanoTime, m -> {}); }
  32:     public Context context(String symbol, String interval, Instant candle, Instant observed, Instant block) {
  33:         return new Context(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), symbol, interval, candle, observed, block);
  34:     }
  35:     public void measure(Context context, String stage, boolean alwaysRecord, Runnable work) {
  36:         Instant started = Instant.now();
  37:         long start = nanos.getAsLong();
  38:         String outcome = "FAILED";
  39:         // A BEGIN without END can locate a stuck block. It is not proof of completion.
  40:         if (alwaysRecord) log.info("[FIX-129][BLOCK_BEGIN] context={}, stage={}, thread={}", context, stage, Thread.currentThread().getName());
  41:         try {
  42:             work.run();
  43:             outcome = "RETURNED";
  44:         } finally {
  45:             long elapsed = Math.max(0L, (nanos.getAsLong() - start) / 1_000_000L);
  46:             if (alwaysRecord || elapsed >= 1000 || !"RETURNED".equals(outcome)) {
  47:                 Measurement m = new Measurement(context, stage, started, Instant.now(), elapsed,
  48:                         outcome, Thread.currentThread().getName());
  49:                 // Diagnostic sink failures must never mask the business exception or change retry eligibility.
  50:                 try {
  51:                     log.info("[FIX-129][STAGE_TIMING] context={}, stage={}, elapsedMs={}, outcome={}, thread={}",
  52:                             context, stage, elapsed, outcome, m.threadName());
  53:                     sink.accept(m);
  54:                 } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
  55:                     log.warn("[FIX-129][DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED] stage={}, symbol={}", stage, context.symbol());
  56:                 }
  57:             }
  58:         }
  59:     }
  60: }

src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTimingStore.java
   1: package com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction;
   2: 
   3: import jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy;
   4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
   5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
   6: import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
   7: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
   8: import javax.sql.DataSource;
   9: import java.sql.Timestamp;
  10: import java.time.Instant;
  11: import java.util.concurrent.*;
  12: 
  13: /** FIX-129: bounded, best-effort diagnostics only. Never CallerRuns: no diagnostic
  14:  * JDBC work runs on the ingestion thread. Queue loss and database failure are
  15:  * explicit; these rows are not a complete market-event ledger.
  16:  */
  17: @Service
  18: public class KlineTimingStore {
  19:     private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KlineTimingStore.class);
  20:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
  21:     private final ThreadPoolExecutor writer = new ThreadPoolExecutor(1, 1, 0, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
  22:             new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(256), task -> {
  23:                 Thread thread = new Thread(task, "fix129-diagnostics");
  24:                 thread.setDaemon(true); return thread;
  25:             }, new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
  26:     public KlineTimingStore(DataSource source) {
  27:         jdbc = new JdbcTemplate(source); jdbc.setQueryTimeout(2);
  28:     }
  29:     public void submit(KlineTiming.Measurement m) {
  30:         try { writer.execute(() -> persist(m)); }
  31:         catch (RejectedExecutionException ex) {
  32:             log.warn("[FIX-129][PERSIST_DROPPED] correlationId={}, stage={}; timing remains in logs",
  33:                     m.context().correlationId(), m.stage());
  34:         }
  35:     }
  36:     private void persist(KlineTiming.Measurement m) {
  37:         try {
  38:             var c = m.context();
  39:             // Dedicated thread has no inherited business transaction; single insert only.
  40:             jdbc.update("""
  41:                 INSERT INTO fix129_stage_timing
  42:                 (correlation_id,symbol,interval_code,candle_open_time,observed_at,block_start,
  43:                  stage,started_at,finished_at,elapsed_ms,outcome,thread_name)
  44:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
  45:                 """, c.correlationId(),c.symbol(),c.interval(),ts(c.candleOpenTime()),ts(c.observedAt()),
  46:                     ts(c.blockStart()),m.stage(),ts(m.startedAt()),ts(m.finishedAt()),m.elapsedMs(),m.outcome(),m.threadName());
  47:         } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
  48:             log.warn("[FIX-129][PERSIST_FAILED] correlationId={}, stage={}; timing remains in logs",
  49:                     m.context().correlationId(),m.stage(),ex);
  50:         }
  51:     }
  52:     private static Timestamp ts(Instant value) { return value == null ? null : Timestamp.from(value); }
  53:     @PreDestroy public void shutdown() {
  54:         // Do not delay market shutdown for diagnostics. Already queued records may be lost on process exit.
  55:         writer.shutdown();
  56:     }
  57: }

## FINDINGS

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** No trade-specific database evidence exists in the permitted `db/CODEX` directory. Therefore no timing, log, protection, or causation conclusion is supportable for frozen trades `182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137`.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The live input path is ordered: input commit → protection transaction → observer transaction → closed-candle dispatch. The input commit is deliberately separate from protection. A protection failure after input commit requires durable price-event evidence; it is not disproved by callback completion alone. [KlineTransactionCoordinator.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTransactionCoordinator.java:36)

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Timing persistence is incomplete by design. `fix129_stage_timing` records only failed or ≥1-second stages, is asynchronously written through a bounded queue, and may be dropped or fail to persist. Absence of a timing row cannot prove that a stage did not run or completed quickly. [KlineTiming.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTiming.java:35) [KlineTimingStore.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTimingStore.java:13)

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Two independent correlation IDs exist: WebSocket receipt correlation and `KlineTiming` context correlation are each newly generated UUIDs. They cannot be joined to each other by ID. Cross-stage reconstruction instead requires symbol, interval, candle-open time, observed time, and subsequently persisted signal/position links. [KlineReceipt.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/client/binance/websocket/KlineReceipt.java:13) [KlineTiming.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTiming.java:32)

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Signal-save logs contain signal ID, candle close time, generated/created timestamps, and calculated close-to-generation/insertion delay. The log explicitly warns that row-created time is not database commit time and a saved signal is not evidence of a wallet trade. [CandleClosedAnalysisWorker.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/indicator/event/CandleClosedAnalysisWorker.java:215)

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The locally retained active application log covers only `2026-10-19 14:32:18.902` through `14:32:36.235`; its prefix has no stated timezone, so it is not labelled as UTC or KSA. It contains no match for the six IDs in position-id style log fields. This does not establish that no relevant events occurred. The retained compressed application archives are dated 12–17 October; no 28 October application log is present locally.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Accepted protection evidence remains `market_price_event` rows with delivery status `LEGACY` or `APPLIED`; candle OHLC cannot replace those observations. [MarketPriceEventService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/market/service/MarketPriceEventService.java:118)

- **EXTERNAL RESEARCH:** None.

- **AGENT INFERENCE:** Because none of the six position IDs has a confirmed symbol, entry/exit time, or signal link, attempting broad log attribution would risk associating unrelated events.

```sql
SELECT
    c.table_name,
    c.ordinal_position,
    c.column_name,
    c.data_type,
    c.column_type,
    c.is_nullable,
```
